device.model: SpectraMax plate reader (SoftMax Pro Automation API)
device.name: SpectraMax plate reader (spectramax.Spectramax)

facts.text: Spectramax is the Python wrapper around the SoftMax Pro Automation API
initialize() creates an SMPAutomationClient, connects it to a server and port, and returns False if the connection fails
get_data() returns the current plate data as a tab-delimited string, or None on error
get_instrument_status() returns the status string stored by the InstrumentStatusChanged event
set_temperature() sets the incubator temperature in Celsius; 0 turns the incubator off
read_UVVis() takes a .spr method file and a results base path, starts the read, saves a .sda file and exports COLUMNS .csv and .xml files
read_UVVis() waits up to 120 s for the read command to complete
The automation interface queues commands and returns their results through CommandCompleted events
